title: A specialist following the hub skill sets an "is there anything new" watcher with a --check pre-check, and a simple reminder without one
note: System prompt — the version's plugins/hub-base/skills/hub/SKILL.md. Model and effort as for hub sessions. Metric: whether --check is in the schedule command. Without --check every tick of the watcher is a full session turn.

commands_i_run.description: the exact shell commands you run in this turn, one per line

turns.input:
Agent mail: sorts the owner's mail through the CLI `mailcli` (`mailcli list --unread --json` prints unread emails as a JSON array). Folder /home/x/agents/mail.

[hub:m40 from user] Check my mail every 5 minutes and write to me if something new came in.

Agent tracker: keeps the owner's tasks in the tracker through the CLI `trk` (`trk search 'assignee = me AND updated > -10m' --json`). Folder /home/x/agents/tracker.

[hub:m41 from user] Keep an eye on my tracker: every 5 minutes look whether there are new tasks or comments assigned to me, and write if something shows up.

Agent mail: sorts the owner's mail through the CLI `mailcli`. Folder /home/x/agents/mail.

[hub:m42 from user] Remind me tomorrow at 9 am to reply to the accountant.
